<!--
Thanks for contributing to CaptureSpike!

The release-drafter bot reads the PR title and labels
to build the changelog, so write the title in a way
that makes sense in a changelog. Examples:

  Fix: normalize pass preserves input audio codec
  Add: per-take Notes section with markdown editor
  Refactor: extract lavfi graph into FilterGraphBuilder

Bad:
  wip
  stuff
  fixed that thing

The body should explain the "why", not just the "what".
The diff shows the "what" already.

Before submitting, make sure:
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] dotnet build src/CaptureSpike.Core.Tests passes
- [ ] All test runner tests pass (run
      dotnet src/CaptureSpike.Core.Tests/bin/Debug/net10.0/CaptureSpike.Core.Tests.dll -parallel none)
- [ ] CLA agreed (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Issue linked (if any): Fixes #___ or Refs #___
- [ ] Title is a single sentence
-->
